_note: Oldest-end sweep batch 65: 1-2 April 2026. Completes April 2026. Model claude-opus-5, prompt v1.

mentions.claim_text: He prays over them and asks God to protect them, says he sees them and that they know the consequences, and prays over their friends and over their friends in South Korea.
mentions.quote: I see those. They know the consequences
mentions.falsify_match: Something befalling people in South Korea.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. Who they are and what the consequences are is not stated.

mentions.claim_text: He reports that if his people called by his name will humble themselves, that he has more plans for America, and that the path will be averted for a window for this season, repeating averted, and says he sees a splitting.
mentions.quote: the path will be averted for a window for this season
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable by construction: the bad path not arriving is the aversion working, and its arriving is the failure to humble.

mentions.claim_text: He says the greater the outcome the greater the turning, repeated, tells them to pray for protection over the gathering, and that it should be a cultivation in their churches and they should pray in their churches.
mentions.quote: the greater the outcome the greater the turning
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: a proportion between two unmeasured things.

mentions.claim_text: He says they have April, May, June and July and can turn this thing through prayer, and that once they turn that corner through August the decisions will start to be made and it is like it is set in stone and they start to see it set in stone.
mentions.quote: once we turn that corner through August the decisions will start to be made
mentions.falsify_match: Decisions hardening from August that could not be changed afterwards.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. It gives prayer a four month deadline and then closes the window, which means anything after August is settled rather than falsified.

mentions.claim_text: He speaks of the governor over Florida and says right now he sees this, the African man with the beard, and to pray for him, asks whether he is running for governor, and reads that Byron Donalds is officially running for governor of Florida in the 2026 election.
mentions.quote: the man with the beard. Pray for him. Is he running for being a governor?
mentions.falsify_match: The named man winning the Florida governorship.
mentions.falsify_miss: He loses. The candidacy was already announced and is read off the screen, so only the outcome is forward-looking.

mentions.claim_text: He says that is the only place they can be found because there are a lot of impersonators, that searching Facebook and Instagram will turn up people who are not them, and asks for a clip from June the 1st to be played back.
mentions.falsify_match: n/a: a warning about fake accounts using his name.

mentions.claim_text: He says it is interesting that the rocket went up today, that he told them the Lord said on April 1st and they prayed about it on April 1st, and that he said they are going to have a new base on the moon and do all these things.
mentions.quote: I said they're going to have a new base on the moon
mentions.falsify_match: A lunar base programme announced. The December and April tellings are both in this corpus, so the recall can be checked against them.
mentions.falsify_miss: No base announced. A rocket launching is not a base, and the mention keeps them apart.

mentions.claim_text: He declares one nation under God and that the best is yet to come, says he stands with the people of Canada and that it will not pass in the Senate, asks whether it has passed over there yet, and confirms it did not pass.
mentions.quote: I stand with the people of Canada, that it will not pass in the Senate
mentions.falsify_match: A named piece of Canadian legislation failing in the Senate, which he then confirms on air.
mentions.falsify_miss: It passes. Which bill is meant is not named in the passage, though the outcome is checkable if it can be identified.

mentions.claim_text: He says he saw the exact plan but that it keeps coming and there are different ones and he keeps praying them down, that the enemy does not want him to succeed because it is about agenda 2030, and that he told them he saw an economy crash worse than the 1929 crash.
mentions.quote: I told you I saw an economy crash worse than 1929 crash
mentions.falsify_miss: None. Praying them down means each plan that does not arrive is a prayer answered rather than a claim missed.

mentions.claim_text: He asks them to play it, says this is July the 7th of 2025 when he gave this word, asks whether anybody remembers it, corrects himself that the Lord gave it through him, and says he has to work from what the word of God says about the days of Noah.
mentions.quote: This is July the 7th of 2025 I gave this word
mentions.falsify_match: Tenth on-air replay of an original recording, and the 7 July 2025 telling is inside this corpus.
mentions.falsify_miss: The clip does not say what he says it says.

mentions.claim_text: He says they are creating organs for transplant and trying to create brains and livers and body parts in labs, asks whether they understand what he just said and calls it creepy, and says that is what he saw, lab grown body parts in a laboratory.
mentions.quote: They were creating lab grown body parts in a laboratory
mentions.falsify_match: Laboratory organ growth for transplant, which is an active field of research.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. The work is already public, so the sight matches something that exists rather than something coming.
